notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.06
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] New Ascension Upgrade nad type of upgrade (in the blue panel).
[*] Added more levels to the Ascension % Boost upgrade to make it easier to get all planets to level 1000. Now each level grants more Galaxy Points.
[*] Added a counter for the total number of rocks destroyed for the achievement.
[/list]

[h2][b]Improvements:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Now you can see the current total ascension points to spend in the ascension tree view.
[*] Upgrades in the blue panel are now more affordable.
[*] Adjusted the prices of some ascension upgrades for better balance.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where rocks appeared behind the cash panel; they now appear in front.
[/list]

Sorry for the delay in the patch; due to various reasons, it took longer than expected. I will continue improving and adding new content! 🪐🚀

[*] Now you can see the current total ascension points to spend in the ascension tree view.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Automaton Purchase:[/b] You can now purchase all available automation aliens with a single click.
[*] [b]Speed Upgrade Purchase:[/b] You can now buy all speed upgrades for automation aliens with a single click.
[/list]

[h2][b]Improvements:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Galactic Points Display:[/b] Galactic points are now displayed with decimals instead of rounding.
[*] [b]Total Planet Production Display:[/b] The total production per second for all planets is now displayed.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Cosmic Sage Achievement:[/b] Fixed the issue with the COSMIC SAGE achievement, which now unlocks correctly.
[/list]

tags.feature: [b]Automaton Purchase:[/b] You can now purchase all available automation aliens with a single click.
[b]Speed Upgrade Purchase:[/b] You can now buy all speed upgrades for automation aliens with a single click.

tags.bug: [b]Cosmic Sage Achievement:[/b] Fixed the issue with the COSMIC SAGE achievement, which now unlocks correctly.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[h2][b]Next Patch Updates:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The prices of ascension upgrades are now cheaper.
[*] You unlock the next ascension level when you buy 1 level of the previous one (except when more than one type of ascension is required to unlock the next one).
[*] After reaching one million ascension points, you continue to gain points incrementally without needing to reach 10% for the next level.
[*] Increased the prices of automation speed upgrades.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: * The prices of ascension upgrades are now cheaper.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Rock Sounds:[/b] Added rock sounds when they spawn (slightly reduced the spawn time).
[*] [b]Next Production Tooltip:[/b] The upgrades tooltip now shows you the next production per second.
[/list]

[h2][b]Improvements:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]AFK Ascension Descriptions:[/b] Modified the description of AFK ascension.
[*] [b]Scrollbar Reset:[/b] Scrollbar now resets to the default position when opening the Automata menu.
[*] [b]Automatic Planet Activation:[/b] When you buy an automaton, the planet will automatically activate its generation.
[*] [b]Right-Click Buy Quantity:[/b] Right-click now decreases the buyer quantity.
[*] [b]Tooltip Refresh:[/b] Tooltips refresh when information changes.
[*] [b]Minerals Display:[/b] You can now see your minerals when the Automata panel is open.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ascension Points Decimals:[/b] Removed unnecessary decimals from Ascension Points.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Next Buy Button:[/b] Implemented a "Next Buy" button for easier purchasing of the next item in sequence.
[*] [b]Brazilian and Latin Spanish Languages:[/b] Added support for Brazilian Portuguese and Latin American Spanish languages.
[/list]
 
[h2][b]Improvements:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Minerals Per Second: [/b] Now, all planets indicate the minerals generated per second.
[*] [b]Buy 10 Upgrades Quantity Changed: [/b] The upgrade quantity options have been updated to x1, x50, x100, NEXT, and MAX.
[*] [b]Minimum 1 Upgrade: [/b] Now, there is always a minimum of 1 upgrade available to buy, regardless of your current cash.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tooltip: [/b] Fixed the issue where the tooltip would remain visible when you shift-tab and exit the game. Now, the tooltip disappears correctly.
[/list]

[b]Brazilian and Latin Spanish Languages:[/b] Added support for Brazilian Portuguese and Latin American Spanish languages.
[b]Minerals Per Second: [/b] Now, all planets indicate the minerals generated per second.

[b]Minimum 1 Upgrade: [/b] Now, there is always a minimum of 1 upgrade available to buy, regardless of your current cash.
